# Multi-solid and void-shell STEP files (#300)

Both are copied unchanged, gzipped (`mtime=0`), from springcraft-ai/brep-conformance 1.0.0
(MIT licence, https://github.com/springcraft-ai/brep-conformance):

- `two_boxes.step.gz`: two `MANIFOLD_SOLID_BREP`s (a sphere and a box).
- `brep_with_voids.step.gz`: one `BREP_WITH_VOIDS` with one void shell, written by OpenCascade.
